career_ladder.note: DRDO Scientist Entry Test / RAC Scientist 'B' recruits entry-level Group 'A' Gazetted R&D officers under the Defence Research & Development Service (DRDS). Promotion from Scientist 'B' onwards operates under the merit-based Flexible Complementing Scheme (FCS) through peer assessment by RAC, where promotion is personal to the scientist regardless of vacancies.

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to Scientist 'B' in DRDO is conducted by the Recruitment and Assessment Centre (RAC). Selection is primarily based on valid GATE score followed by a Personal Interview (85% GATE score + 15% Personal Interview). For disciplines where GATE is not conducted or specialized intake is notified, RAC conducts a Descriptive Examination (Paper I & II, 300 marks each, 3 hours duration each) followed by Personal Interview (80% Descriptive Examination + 20% Personal Interview). The minimum qualifying mark in the interview is 70% for UR and 60% for reserved categories.

financial_package.note: Scientist 'B' in DRDO is a central Group 'A' Gazetted post placed in 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 10 (entry basic ₹56,100 to ₹1,77,500). In addition to central DA, HRA, and Transport Allowance, DRDO scientists receive specialized allowances including Professional Update Allowance, Performance Related Incentive Scheme (PRIS), and medical cover.
financial_package.pay_source_label: DRDO RAC Advt. — Remuneration & Pay Level 10 for Scientist 'B'
financial_package.estimate_note: Entry basic ₹56,100 + 58% DA (₹32,538) + HRA (10%-30%: ₹5,610 to ₹16,830) + Transport Allowance (₹3,600 to ₹7,200 + DA) yields gross ~₹98,000 to ~₹1,25,000. In-hand reflects ~10% NPS deduction and income tax deductions.
official_perks: Professional Update Allowance of ₹22,500 to ₹45,000 per annum based on rank and R&D role
Performance Related Incentive Scheme (PRIS) under Defence R&D framework
Central Government residential accommodation in DRDO housing complexes or full central HRA
Comprehensive medical coverage under CGHS or DRDO laboratory medical facilities
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% defined monthly employer contribution
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and Children Education Allowance (CEA)
